name: @violice/preact-fluent-ui
description: Preact components and explicit Fluent-style CSS for desktop web applications

scripts.format: oxfmt --write src scripts vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json package.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check src scripts vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json package.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json
scripts.build: vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/build-css.mjs && node scripts/check-dist.mjs
